original_test_intent: Execute the authentic NVIDIA Partner Field Diagnostics Level 2 suite on the designated HGX platform and prove every in-scope field module completes with its approved result, while preserving any failure encountered under --run_on_error and demonstrating no hang, reboot or new hardware fault.
original_method: Pin partnerdiag package version, hash/signature/license and supported HGX board/GPU/NVLink/PCIe firmware matrix; inventory the target and drain workloads; identify all Level 2 modules, expected duration, resource and thermal limits, --run_on_error semantics and the explicit BMC exclusion from --no_bmc; preserve baselines; execute the exact source command once in a maintenance window with complete untruncated artifacts and continuous health monitoring; evaluate every item and first error independently rather than trusting final exit/completion; recover without an automatic rerun.
manual_activity: Owner/NVIDIA partner supplies and authorizes the package, supported topology and interpretation; an operator drains the SUT, monitors the maintenance run and owns emergency stop and recovery.
required_inputs: Authentic partnerdiag package/version/hash/signature, license and required libraries/configuration
Exact supported HGX board, GPU/NVLink/PCIe topology and compatible BIOS/BMC/GPU/NIC/retimer firmware/driver matrix
Level 2 module inventory, --run_on_error and --no_bmc scope, per-module acceptance and resource/thermal aborts
Maintenance authorization, durable artifact storage, console/BMC recovery and NVIDIA escalation path
safety_requirements: Use a dedicated idle SUT with adequate cooling/power and out-of-band recovery
Use trusted authenticated access and preserve all pre-test logs and counters
Monitor GPU/NVLink/PCIe/host/BMC thermal, power and error health while the low-level suite runs
Record every earlier failed item even when --run_on_error continues; stop on the approved emergency threshold, hang, reboot or unsafe hardware state
Do not interrupt routinely, clear logs, truncate output or retry automatically
agent_execution_scope: Verify package provenance/support, exact target, module/coverage map, baselines, limits and recovery
Run exactly ./partnerdiag --field --level2 --run_on_error --no_bmc once under approved monitoring
Capture complete stdout/stderr, exit status, per-item artifacts, first failure and correlated platform health
Do not treat final completion as all-pass, claim BMC coverage, use insecure access, rerun faults or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve partnerdiag build/license, topology/firmware compatibility and Level 2 module scope
Define per-item acceptance, --run_on_error interpretation, resource/thermal limits, BMC coverage disposition and recovery
Review all raw module results and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The core partnerdiag arguments match the source, but the insecure wrapper and tail -n 40 destroy required provenance and per-item evidence; --run_on_error requires full-history evaluation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the exact source command from the verified package over trusted access, tee complete stdout/stderr and artifacts without truncation, record exit and each item, and correlate the run with target health and the explicit no-BMC exclusion.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: --field --level2 --run_on_error --no_bmc, all-items/no-hang/no-reboot Criteria, no bundle, and 15/60-minute allocation remain unchanged.

modernized_recommendation.status: HIGH NVIDIA PARTNER FIELD LEVEL2 DIAGNOSTIC QUALIFICATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind every diagnostic item and artifact to the verified package and exact topology, retain the first and all later failures under continuation mode, and correlate low-level activity with platform telemetry and recovery state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds package trust, compatibility, complete module evidence, continuation semantics, scope accounting and monitored recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A last-lines excerpt can omit the first failing module; --no_bmc leaves BMC diagnostics untested, and successful process completion does not imply every item passed.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Level 2 field diagnostics may stress GPU, NVLink and PCIe paths; package behavior is vendor-specific and may leave altered or faulted device state after an error.

project_override_considerations: A newer partnerdiag build can substitute only with NVIDIA/owner approval and an explicit module/coverage delta. BMC coverage remains separate unless --no_bmc is removed under a separately reviewed plan; generic GPU stress is not equivalent.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, owner authorization and package version/hash/signature/license
HGX board and complete GPU/NVLink/PCIe identity plus compatible firmware/driver inventory and clean baseline
Exact command, environment/configuration, start/end timestamps, exit status and complete stdout/stderr
Complete per-item Level 2 results and artifacts including first failure and all --run_on_error continuations
GPU/NVLink/PCIe/driver/dmesg/journal/BMC/SEL/thermal/power pre/during/post evidence and explicit no-BMC gap
Abort/recovery or clean final state and engineer verdict

review_improvement: Preserves all diagnostic items and first-fault evidence from a continuing low-level suite, verifies package trust and platform compatibility, and makes the BMC coverage gap explicit.
independent_technical_reasoning: Because --run_on_error intentionally continues after a module fails, exit or final lines cannot summarize acceptance; every item and the first failure must remain visible. Low-level field diagnostics can stress interconnected GPU/NVLink/PCIe devices, so package-to-topology compatibility and synchronized health telemetry are part of safe interpretation. The --no_bmc option is retained as source intent but must never be reported as full BMC diagnostic coverage.
